_comment: Contract for GET /api/stats on the engine. Optional query: ?session=<session_id>. All rates are 0..1. bb = big blinds. Non-ok decisions are excluded from style stats but counted in error_rate; miss_rate counts only illegal and unparseable ones (the model's own reply, still unusable after its retry). Rates with nothing to count are null. by_players_to_flop always has the keys 2, 3 and 4+. The same model fields appear in the ?session= payload. partial is true while all-ins after a restart are still being worked out (aiev_bb100 then counts them at their actual result). seated is the table's current lineup (seat order); it is present on the all-time payload and on the live session's, and absent for past sessions and until the engine knows its lineup.

_timeline._comment: Contract for GET /api/stats/timeline, the same numbers at past hands; not a field of /api/stats. Same scope as /api/stats: all time, or ?session=<session_id>. Model fields are indexes into models (sorted by name). profiles has a row per model seated so far at every profile_step hands (25, or ceil(hands/120) past 3,000 hands, so never more than 120 snapshots) and at the last hand, whose rows equal /api/stats (bb100 rounded to 0.01, vpip and pfr to 0.0001, af to 0.001; null as in /api/stats). matchups has a row for each pair whose head-to-head net changed, a < b, chips being what a took from b: per hand, or per matchup_bucket hands (ceil(hands/1200)) past 1,200 hands, at the bucket's last hand. Summing chips per pair over every row gives vs.net_chips in /api/stats exactly (b's total against a is minus a's). Example: rows from the demo history, cut to four of its 19 models with the indexes renumbered to match.
